item.description:
Team packs, ready to use

Add an optional private GitHub pack for your team's skills, scenes, personas and workspace appearance. Compatible pack updates preserve existing sessions and personal copies. Everyday Workbench tools remain account-free.

Hand off selected transcripts

Choose captures from Recent transcripts, mark them as your instructions or reference material, and optionally include a Snap & Talk session. Workbench prepares the folder and prompt for your chosen assistant.

Existing branded sessions remain usable. New company content comes from your team's private pack. Read the team guide.

Install the optional ServiceNow Snap & Talk skill pack once, then use it for new sessions. Each session keeps its own instructions, branding assets and helper scripts for handoff to your chosen agent. Neutral remains the initial default; existing and custom sessions keep their files. Thanks to Matt for the original branding and deck helpers.

Workbench also keeps normal Mac commands such as Command-Q available. Core presenter shortcuts use Option plus one key. Safe custom choices are retained; duplicate saved assignments are paused with a repair explanation in Keyboard.

Includes the packaged New session crash fix from 2.0.1. Mac desktop quality remains the priority; iOS, iPadOS and Chrome extension work is paused.

Workbench 2.0.1

Fixes a crash when creating a new Snap & Talk session in a downloaded Mac app. Existing captures, narration and session files are preserved. Thanks to Matt for the fix.

Packaging now checks session creation from the exact delivered app. Workbench remains the public Mac app; the purple-P Preview edition is for development. iOS, iPadOS and Chrome extension work remains paused.
